Lewitus 2014 trait table vs the volumes merge; 28/33 species overlap. NOT superseded, two reasons. (1) MECHANISM: the app builds its coverage map from the four MERGE files only (app.R load_compiled: cov <- split(merges$Species, merges$Variable)), and volumes_long is a BASE dataset. A supersede row here would relabel the Lewitus rows to "Neocortex_Vol.mm3 (mm3)" but drop nothing, producing two conflicting rows per species instead of one. (2) DATA: only 18/28 overlapping species agree within 1% — Macaca mulatta differs 15%, Perodicticus potto 19%, Nycticebus coucang 6.192 vs 5831 (a unit or transcription discrepancy at source). Different measurements, not a duplicate label.

Lewitus 2014 vs the volumes merge; 27/27 overlapping species agree exactly, so the values ARE the same measurement (Lewitus carried the Stephan-collection numbers). Still not superseded: same mechanism limit as Neocortex_mm^3 — the supersede target must be a merge label, and volumes_long is a base dataset. Revisit if the volumes merge is ever promoted to a std_merge() source; then this becomes a clean supersede with 5 fallback species (Aotus nancymaae, Galago demidoff, Gorilla gorilla gorilla, Otolemur garnettii, Saimiri boliviensis boliviensis).

Iwaniuk et al. 1999 ordinal diet code vs Wilman 2014 Diet_dominant. 22/25 species overlap but 0/22 values agree: Iwaniuk prints integers 0-4, Wilman prints category names ("Endotherm vertebrates", "Fruit"). Different coding schemes for a related concept — not a duplicate.

Iwaniuk et al. 1999 hand-eye score vs the behaviour merge Dexterity (1-7 scale). All 25 species overlap but only 2/25 values agree: Iwaniuk runs 0-2, Dexterity runs 1-7. Different scales, no published crosswalk in the repo, so no to_canonical_factor can be justified.

Iwaniuk et al. 1999 ordinal arboreality vs the behaviour merge Arboreal_terrestrial (category). Only 5/25 species overlap — far below the near-total overlap the supersede convention requires, and superseding would hide 20 species behind a relabel.

Heffner & Masterton 1975 penetration depth vs Bortoff & Strick 1993 CST_termination_grade. 1/43 species overlap (the merge has only 2 species: Sapajus apella, Saimiri sciureus). Different methods and near-disjoint species sets.

Lewitus 2014 prints a COMBINED fruit+seed percentage; Wilman 2014 partitions the same diet space into separate Diet_Fruit and Diet_Seed. Superseding onto Diet_Fruit alone would silently discard the seed component. Different partitions of one concept, not a duplicate column.
